Preserves the Runtime implementation and its continuation checkpoint so a fresh Agent 0 can resume from a published branch. Adds the delegated v2 daemon/client/CLI path, private authenticated supervisor, exact Codex actor, consent/approval and retirement handling, actual Pi/oMLX child composition, and hosted Codex conformance admission.

Hosted Codex acquisition remains fail-closed without complete externally accepted conformance and the accepted supplier identity. This is not a product release: the second supplier build is interrupted with no artifact, P1/P2/P4 canary repairs and P3/native approval coverage remain, and source/account/hold decisions are unchanged. Local Pi and legacy v1 remain separate paths. No jobs were installed and no account was imported.

Actual local Pi and selected separately identified supplier canaries are preserved alongside failed attempts, independent reviews and lossless evidence packaging. The handoff explains the implementation approach, exact unfinished work, retained local supplier artifacts and resume order. Read `projects/chirality-runtime/execution/_Coordination/AgentRuns/RUNTIME_EXECUTION_2026-09-06/AGENT0_HANDOFF.md` and `PR_PUBLICATION.md` first; the manager checkpoint is historical where later PR repair evidence supersedes it.

Validation: build/typecheck pass; Runtime **474 passed, 8 opt-in skipped**; affected **825 passed plus 9 subtests**; entrypoints/G0–G4/harness/whitespace pass; 43 accepted basis hashes unchanged. The first full-suite failures remain recorded. Their repairs preserve shutdown time limits and permanently invalidate retired process generations; the independent backcheck passed. All 452 frozen first-party code/dist/test/manifest hashes matched after the final suite.

Linux CI also exposed two fixture-boundary issues, corrected in a test-only follow-up: macOS immutable-file checks now declare their platform and test unsupported-platform rejection; approval assertions hold their real fixture worker behind a bounded host-release barrier. Production checks are unchanged. The full Linux Runtime suite subsequently passed, but App Electron startup failed on a binary download. A retry exposed a combined startup-test budget; its two independent cases are now separated with unchanged deadlines (local standalone 13/13 pass). A further rotation-case timeout exposed the same composite budget issue: multi-job tests now allow 30s total while individual readiness/rejection/shutdown retain explicit 5s bounds. Local standalone13/13 and independent review pass; production code remains unchanged. All outcomes are preserved. Consult the latest PR check results for the current full Linux/App verdict.

The final controlled login fixture also allows 1000ms for the ceremony, including real child startup, and verifies pending-to-failed within a 2000ms poll; all six focused tests pass. Production timeout and consent enforcement are unchanged.

Current CI / successor first action (head `19714cd72`, run [34019371445](https://github.com/sgttomas/chirality/actions/runs/34019371445)): the complete Linux Runtime suite passed; governance and PEC checks passed. App registration failed because Electron/CommonJS loading reports `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` for `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`. This is a remaining Runtime/App packaging integration blocker, distinct from the earlier Electron download failure. Diagnose the Runtime import/bundling boundary before requesting merge; frontend and shared workflow files were not edited. The PR is not merge-ready, and this result does not authorize broadening the implementation scope or resuming supplier builds. This is the latest publication handoff supplement to the committed `AGENT0_HANDOFF.md` and `PR_PUBLICATION.md`.
